references.text: The Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the testimony and keep guard over it, so that wrath may not come upon the congregation of Israel.
The Levites shall perform the service for Aaron and for all the congregation before the tent of meeting; they shall take care of everything pertaining to the tabernacle.

The Levites are given to Aaron and his sons to serve on behalf of the Israelites in the tent of meeting and to make atonement for them, so that no plague may come upon the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.
Aaron took the censer and made atonement for the people after wrath had broken out from the presence of the Lord; he stopped the plague.
Aron's staff was placed before the testimony as a sign to the rebellious, to stop their grumbling so that they would not die.
Nadab and Abihu offered strange fire before the presence of the Lord, and fire went out from the Lord and consumed them—an example of God's wrath when the sanctuary is not treated with reverence.
The Levites and priests are urged to carry out their service for the Lord and not be negligent, for the Lord has chosen them to stand before his presence.
The sons of Zadok, the Levitical priests, shall approach the Lord to serve him and keep guard at my sanctuary.

The priests continually enter the first tent to perform their service, but into the second only the high priest enters once a year, not without blood which he offers for himself and for the sins committed in ignorance by the people.
